headline: BRVM Composite Index Rebounds CFA 218 Billion Ending Two Weeks of Losses
summary: West Africa's regional stock market gained CFA 218.32 billion in market value as the BRVM Composite Index rose 1.05% to 534.71 points, led by equities like Bernabe.
why: The Bourse Régionale des Valeurs Mobilières (BRVM) serves eight West African Francophone nations within the WAEMU region.
